process_steps.description: Nickel nitrate and copper nitrate solutions mixed 1:1

source.quote: 10 mL of nickel nitrate solution (0.25 M) and 10 mL of copper nitrate solution (0.25 M) were mixed in a 1:1 ratio

process_steps.description: Sodium hydroxide added dropwise with vigorous stirring on a heating stirrer

source.quote: 100 mL of 0.5 M sodium hydroxide solution was added dropwise to the solution on a heating stirrer with vigorous stirring at 60 °C for 2 h

process_steps.description: Precipitate washed four times with water and ethanol on Whatman paper

source.quote: the precipitate on the Whatman paper was washed four times with water and ethanol to remove unreacted substances
The obtained sediment was heated in an oven at 80 °C for 3 h to remove excess water

process_steps.description: Dried sediment crushed in a porcelain mortar

source.quote: the dried sediment was crushed in a porcelain mortar

process_steps.description: Powder fired to form NiO–CuO nanoparticles

source.quote: The sample was then fired at a temperature of 400 °C for 4 h

process_steps.description: Chitosan stirred in distilled water with 1% v/v acetic acid at room temperature

source.quote: 1 g of chitosan was stirred in distilled water containing 1% v/v acetic acid for 1 h at room temperature

process_steps.description: Starch stirred in distilled water to a 1.5% w/v solution

source.quote: 0.375 g of starch was stirred in distilled water at a temperature at 90 °C for 1 h to obtain a 1.5% w/v starch solution

process_steps.description: PVA stirred in distilled water to a 1% w/v solution

source.quote: 0.5 g of PVA was stirred in distilled water at 70 °C for 1 h until a solution of 1% w/v was obtained

process_steps.description: PVA, starch and chitosan solutions combined in a 4:2:4 ratio

source.quote: Next, we prepared a PVA/ST/CS 1% solution in a 4:2:4 ratio

process_steps.description: NiO–CuO nanoparticles added to the mixture

source.quote: different percentages of NiO–CuONPs (0.5%, 1%, and 2% w/w) based on dry chitosan, starch, and PVA were added to the prepared mixture
The solution was stirred at 70 °C for 1 h until a homogeneous solution was obtained

process_steps.description: 15 mL poured into an 8 cm polystyrene plate

source.quote: 15 mL of the mixture was poured into a polystyrene plate with a diameter of 8 cm
dried at laboratory temperature, e.g. 25 °C
